title.narrative: Safeguarding reality in a virtual world: Enhancing protection, resilience and empowerment of your migrants and Moroccans vulnerable to digital risks

description.narrative: The proposed analysis aims to strengthen national capacities in Morocco to promote a secure, inclusive and ethically governed digital environment for vulnerable youth, with particular attention to migrant and displaced young people, in the context of accelerated digital transformation. Grounded in a Human Security approach, the initiative addresses interconnected digital risks, including disinformation, hate speech, online exploitation, cybercrime and emerging AI-related harms, that increasingly affect youth safety, social cohesion and access to opportunities. Through a multidimensional situation analysis, institutional capacity mapping, and inclusive sectoral consultations, the project will identify structural gaps in media and information literacy, digital resilience and protection mechanisms, particularly for marginalized youth facing compounded vulnerabilities. The initiative will culminate in the co-creation of a nationally aligned, time-bound operational framework defining roles, accountability mechanisms and priority actions. Engaging government institutions, civil society organizations, academia, frontline professionals, media actors and the UN Country Team, the programme aligns with the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, and international commitments on cybercrime and responsible AI governance, contributing to strengthened youth protection, informed policymaking and resilient digital ecosystems.
